# Amara Interior Design

> Amara is a luxury interior design and procurement studio with offices in Miami, Dubai, and Paris. We create bespoke residential and hospitality interiors defined by calm, balance, natural materials, and timeless craftsmanship.

## About

Amara designs interior spaces where listening, materials, and light guide every decision. Our work spans luxury residences, boutique hotels, and hospitality venues across the globe. We believe design begins with people — their rituals, their rhythm, their dreams.

## Services

- Concept Development: From initial vision to detailed design narratives
- Interior Design: Full-service luxury residential and hospitality interiors
- Procurement: Global procurement of bespoke furniture, materials, and artisan pieces
- Project Management: End-to-end coordination from design through installation

## Locations

- Miami, Florida, USA
- Dubai, United Arab Emirates
- Paris, France
